title: Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi Final Trailer Revealed Ahead of August 5 Release
content: Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi revealed its final trailer, giving the last look at the upcoming anime series ahead of its August 5, 2026 premiere on Disney+ and Hulu. All 8 episodes will begin streaming at once.
author: Anime Corner

title: Crunchyroll's Anime Nights to Screen Webtoon-Based Korean-Animated Film Your Letter on August 17
content: Crunchyroll confirmed on Monday that the WEBTOON -based Korean-animated film Your Letter will join its Crunchyroll Anime Nights theatrical screening program. The film will screen in Korean with English subtitles in the U.S. and Canada for one night on August 17. Tickets went on sale on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 'One Piece Day' Event Streams Worldwide on YouTube on August 22-23
content: The stream will be available on August 22 from 6:15 p.m. to 7:45 p.m. JST (5:15 a.m. to 6:45 a.m. EDT) and on August 23 from 10:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. JST (from August 22 at 9:30 p.m. to August 23 at 5:30 a.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: Fairy Tail Creator Confirms More Projects After Manga’s Return
content: Hiro Mashima is one of the most renowned manga creators of all time, known for creating several series and one-shots. His most famous work is Fairy Tail , an action fantasy, remains his most popular series even now.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Confirms Deku’s Official Pro Hero Name After Anime Finale Timeskip
content: My Hero Academia has officially ended the anime with one final release taking on Kohei Horikoshi’s original manga , and with this special finale has finally given Deku his official name as a pro hero.
author: ComicBook

title: One of Shonen Jump’s Biggest Anime Ever Returns to Crunchyroll After Surprise Removal
content: One of Shonen Jump ‘s biggest anime of all time has made its return to Crunchyroll after its surprise removal earlier this year, so now it’s the perfect time to catch up with it all.

title: Black Clover Creator Shares Emotional Final Goodbye to Fans After Finale

title: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked Anime Casts Yō Taichi
content: NBC Universal revealed a new cast member for the television anime of Otsuji 's My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked ( Ibitte Konai Gibo to Gishi ) manga (the Japanese manga and anime write the English title as: My mother-in-law and sister-in-law who don't bully me. ) on Monday.
